components.name: Primary button
components.description: Blue action for transcription, upload, or export.
components.css: .ds-primary { font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.45; font-weight: 500; padding: 7px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #cdd4df); border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; transition: background-color 150ms, color 150ms; background: var(--accent, #245bd6); border-color: var(--accent, #245bd6); color: #ffffff; } .ds-primary:hover { background: #1947ac; } .ds-primary:active { background: var(--accent, #245bd6); } .ds-primary:disabled { background: #e9edf2; border-color: var(--border, #cdd4df); color: #677384; cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #245bd6); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-primary { transition-duration: 0ms; } }

components.html: Leave blank for auto. Use a code such as en or th.
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; color: #35465c; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.45; } .ds-field { font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.45; color: #192332; background: var(--surface, #ffffff); padding: 7px 9px; min-width: 0; border: 1px solid var(--border, #cdd4df); border-radius: 6px; } .ds-field::placeholder { color: #596677; opacity: 1; } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #245bd6); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-field-hint { display: block; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.45; color: var(--muted, #526072); margin-top: 6px; }

components.name: File navigation
components.description: Flat file rows with hover and a current-file selection wash.
components.css: .ds-library { background: #f7f8fa; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-file { display: block; width: 100%; border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: #192332; text-align: left; padding: 12px 16px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.45; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms, color 150ms; } .ds-file:hover { background: #e9edf2; } .ds-file.ds-current { background: #e9f0ff; color: #1947ac; } .ds-file:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #245bd6); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-file-name { display: block; overflow: hidden; white-space: nowrap; text-overflow: ellipsis; font-weight: 500; } .ds-file-state { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; margin-top: 3px; color: var(--muted, #526072); font-size: 12px; } .ds-current .ds-file-state { color: #226742; } .ds-file-time { margin-left: auto; font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Consolas, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 11px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-file { transition-duration: 0ms; } }

components.name: Upload picker
components.description: A dashed file-input target becomes a solid blue border after selection.
components.css: .ds-picker { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: center; min-height: 86px; padding: 12px; background: var(--surface, #ffffff); color: #192332; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.45; border: 1px dashed #8492a6; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .ds-picker:hover { border-color: var(--accent, #245bd6); background: #f3f6fd; } .ds-picker:focus-within { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #245bd6); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-picker.ds-has-file { border-style: solid; border-color: var(--accent, #245bd6); } .ds-picker input { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; opacity: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-picker-hint { font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted, #526072); }

narrative.overview:
The code-first transcription workspace is an Operate surface: quiet, light, compact, and focused on listening and correcting text. The user-pinned visual world combines a light gray workspace, a dark playback surface, system fonts, monospaced times, and one blue accent.

Flat panels and separators organize the work. The visual system uses plain labels, readable text, and visible interaction states. The implementation is the reference for measured values; the source files are `web/src/style.css`, `web/src/App.tsx`, `web/src/Editor.tsx`, `web/src/SegmentList.tsx`, and `web/src/Waveform.tsx`.
keyCharacteristics: Quiet light workspace with a dark player.
System sans type and tabular monospaced times.
One blue accent for action, selection, and focus.
Compact controls and flat panel separators.
Responsive playback, waveform, and transcript layout.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Use blue for interactive emphasis; reserve red, green, and brown for their existing status meanings.

rules.name: The Time Legibility Rule
rules.body: Keep time values monospaced and tabular; use system sans type for editable transcript text.

rules.name: The Flat Panels Rule
rules.body: Separate workspace regions with tone and borders rather than decorative cards or elevation.

dos: **Do** keep the light workspace, dark playback surface, and single blue accent.
**Do** use system fonts, tabular monospaced times, and short plain labels.
**Do** preserve Unicode, punctuation, and visible unsaved drafts.
**Do** use flat separators, compact controls, and the observed responsive order.
**Do** keep focus visible and recovery actions beside the state they resolve.
donts: **Don't** introduce decorative imagery, extra accent colors, shadows, or card framing.
**Don't** replace native media controls with decorative playback chrome.
**Don't** use decorative symbols in UI labels or invent progress estimates.
**Don't** let long names or fixed dimensions force horizontal page overflow.
